name: second-brain-plugin-api
description: Types for writing Second Brain plugins (the PluginAPI a plugin's onload receives).

scripts.build: dts-bundle-generator --project ../../frontend/tsconfig.json --external-imports react --no-banner -o index.d.ts ../../frontend/lib/plugins/api.ts && node -e "const v=require('fs').readFileSync('index.d.ts','utf8').match(/PLUGIN_API_VERSION = (\\d+)/)[1];require('fs').writeFileSync('index.js','export const PLUGIN_API_VERSION = '+v+';\\n')"
